information.en: Research-only white matter lesion segmentation of a FLAIR series with FLAMeS.

regulatory_information.safety_advices: Research use only. Automated lesion masks can miss lesions or include artefacts and must be reviewed before use.
regulatory_information.special_operating_instructions: OpenRecon FLAMeS white matter lesion segmentation of a reconstructed FLAIR series
regulatory_information.additional_relevant_information: The scanner receives a lesion overlay and a lesion mask on the source grid. The lesion table remains in the run workspace.

information.en: Select the FLAMeS MRD server configuration.
Return a restamped copy of the FLAIR before the lesion series.

Fold 0 takes about 90 s on 8 CPU threads. The ensemble averages all five published folds and takes about five times as long; on held-out scans it raised Dice from 0.61 to 0.65 for multiple sclerosis lesions.
By default SynthStrip finds the brain first. Enable this only when the FLAIR is already brain-only, so nonzero voxels are used as the brain.
Also return the lesion probability map, scaled from 0 to 1000.
